name: ssbmod
expr: yL = ssbmod(x, fc, fs); yU = ssbmod(x, fc, fs, 0, 'upper'); yP = ssbmod(x, fc, fs, pi/4);
comment: MATLAB ssbmod: single-sideband modulator. y = x.*cos(2π·Fc·t + ini) ± imag(hilbert(x)).*sin(2π·Fc·t + ini); +sign for default lower sideband, -sign for 'upper'. Hilbert is FFT-based -> ~1e-10 ULP-level deviation from MATLAB. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship ssbmod in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
